{"content": "import sys
import platform
import shutil

print("=" * 50)
print("Python 环境检测报告")
print("=" * 50)

print(f"\n【当前 Python】")
print(f"  版本: {sys.version}")
print(f"  可执行文件: {sys.executable}")
print(f"  平台: {platform.platform()}")
print(f"  架构: {platform.machine()}")

print(f"\n【系统中可用的 Python】")
python_versions = ['python', 'python3', 'python3.13', 'python3.12', 'python3.11']
found = False
for ver in python_versions:
    path = shutil.which(ver)
    if path:
        found = True
        print(f"  ✓ {ver}: {path}")

if not found:
    print("  ⚠ 未找到标准 Python 命令")

print(f"\n【pip 信息】")
try:
    import pip
    print(f"  pip 位置: {pip.__file__}")
except ImportError:
    print("  ⚠ 未找到 pip")

print(f"\n【虚拟环境】")
try:
    import venv
    print(f"  ✓ venv 模块可用")
except ImportError:
    print("  ⚠ venv 模块不可用")

print("\n" + "=" * 50)
print("检测完成")
print("=" * 50)
", "filename": "test_py313.py", "project": "P5_T044"}

print(f"  平台: {platform.platform()}")
print(f"  架构: {platform.machine()}")

print(f"\n【系统中可用的 Python】")
python_versions = ['python', 'python3', 'python3.13', 'python3.12', 'python3.11']
found = False
for ver in python_versions:
    path = shutil.which(ver)
    if path:
        found = True
        print(f"  ✓ {ver}: {path}")

if not found:
    print("  ⚠ 未找到标准 Python 命令")

# 检查 pip
print(f"\n【pip 信息】")
try:
    import pip
    print(f"  pip 位置: {pip.__file__}")
except ImportError:
    print("  ⚠ 未找到 pip")

# 检查 venv
print(f"\n【虚拟环境】")
try:
    import venv
    print(f"  ✓ venv 模块可用")
except ImportError:
    print("  ⚠ venv 模块不可用")

print("\n" + "=" * 50)
print("检测完成")
print("=" * 50)
